pyqgis_plugin.name: Pre-600 BCE Subcontinent APM Discovery GIS
pyqgis_plugin.description: Archaeological Predictive Modeling (APM) & Multi-Sensor Prospection for Pre-600 BCE Tells across the Indian Subcontinent.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Enables field archaeologists, heritage surveyors, and university research teams to load prospective Pre-600 BCE tell anomalies, inspect 4-stage hybrid telemetry (Orengo RF, MSRM CNN, AlphaEarth), verify 1500m exclusion buffers around 97 canonical monuments, and export ODK/KoboToolbox mobile ground survey forms.
